symbols.name: run_migrations_offline
symbols.docstring:
Run migrations in 'offline' mode.

This configures the context with just a URL
and not an Engine, though an Engine is acceptable
here as well.  By skipping the Engine creation
we don't even need a DBAPI to be available.

Calls to context.execute() here emit the given string to the
script output.

symbols.name: run_migrations_online
symbols.docstring:
Run migrations in 'online' mode.

In this scenario we need to create an Engine
and associate a connection with the context.

label.name: Project Entry Point
label.summary: Contains the main application script, configuration files, and top-level test suite for the project.

label.name: Core Application Package
label.summary: Houses the central application logic including database models, search functionality, and background task management.

label.name: Database Migration Setup
label.summary: Provides the environment configuration and scripts necessary for managing database schema evolution.

label.name: Main Feature Routes
label.summary: Implements the primary web routes and user input forms for the core microblogging functionality.

label.name: RESTful API Services
label.summary: Provides programmatic endpoints for user management, authentication tokens, and external data access.

label.name: Global Error Handlers
label.summary: Manages custom error pages and exception handling logic for the web application.

label.name: User Authentication Module
label.summary: Handles user identity management including registration, login, and password recovery workflows.

label.name: Schema Migration History
label.summary: Stores sequential version scripts that track incremental changes to the database tables and relationships.
